cards.title: Big task? No problem.
cards.dek: Hand it something too big for one sitting. An architect reads your repository, decides what the work actually is, and a roster of agents runs the pieces in parallel while you watch the board.

go.goal: Read this repository, decide what the work actually is, and run the pieces in parallel.

cards.title: Let an agent drive your browser
cards.dek: Describe the journey in words. The agent opens your app, clicks through it, reads the console, and writes the test for the path it just proved works.

go.prompt: Use the Playwright MCP server to walk the main journey through this app, read the console as you go, and write the test for the path you proved works.

cards.title: Build a 3D apocalypse of your own street
cards.dek: Photorealistic tiles of your actual postcode, streamed into Unreal, with something unpleasant wandering up the road. Walk from the pavement into your own front door.

go.prompt: Point the Cesium tiles at my postcode, bring the street into Unreal, and put something unpleasant at the far end of the road.

cards.title: Give your app a design system it actually follows
cards.dek: The agent reads the UI you already have, pulls out the colours and spacing you keep repeating by hand, writes them down as tokens — then fails the build when something drifts.

cards.title: Put an agent in your Telegram
cards.dek: Ask how the sprint is going from the pub. Approve a plan from the bus. The same run you left on the desktop, answering in a chat you already have open.

cards.title: Have the review done before you open the PR
cards.dek: Every push to a branch starts a review agent. By the time you go looking, the findings are waiting — with the ones it could not confirm already thrown out.

cards.title: Let the agent see the type errors you can
cards.dek: Without a language server an agent guesses at your types from context. With one it reads the same squiggles your editor draws — and stops proposing code that was never going to compile.

go.prompt: Use the language server to find every type error in this repository and fix the ones you are sure about.
